channel.title: Comoloc Blog
channel.description: Practical notes on localization, AI and translation quality.

item.title: AI + Human Localization: How to Get Speed Without Losing Quality
item.description: How to combine AI translation with expert linguists for faster, more cost-efficient localization without sacrificing quality. A practical, step-by-step workflow.

item.title: MQM Explained: How to Measure Translation Quality Objectively
item.description: A practical introduction to MQM (Multidimensional Quality Metrics): error categories, severity levels, scoring and how to use it to evaluate human, machine and AI translation.

item.title: Localizing Games into Turkish: 7 Pitfalls to Avoid
item.description: Seven common pitfalls when localizing games into Turkish, from suffixes and string variables to the Turkish I problem, fonts, UI space, plurals, number formats and tone.
